dict.string: Crucial needs access to scan and clean idle developer caches, build artifacts, and junk files on your Desktop.
Crucial needs access to scan and clean idle project caches, node_modules, and build artifacts in Documents.
Crucial needs access to identify large, idle installer images (DMGs, PKGs, ZIPs) in your Downloads folder.
Crucial needs administrative access to inspect system caches, Xcode DerivedData, and orphaned application residue.
Crucial requires Full Disk Access to scan all junk categories, DerivedData, and orphaned application residue without prompting repeatedly.
